description: The frozen faithfulness judge (eval/scripts/freeze_judge.py, docs/prompts.md): the owner-designated winner of judge selection. Generation-mode comparisons only run against it; any change to a faithfulness prompt invalidates earlier ones.

accepted_misses.justification: Owner's exception (docs/prompts.md, 'Frozen judge: baseline v3'). Q008-p1-negation is judged supported in 6 of 6 repeats across both v3 runs (rerun: prompt_cmp_judge_default_n28_20261011T103203Z), with a self-contradicting reason; the only prompt fix tried (judge-negation-opt) moved no negation verdict and collapsed the faithful-class mean (0.671 -> 0.175). Known limitation: this judge does not reliably detect a negation that reverses a sentence's meaning; it rejects the negated claim itself on 1 of 4 negation items (Q004-p1 only; the gate's 3/4 credits Q002-p2 and Q010-p2 through collateral flags). Generation comparisons must not rely on it to catch that kind of error.
